req.title: Redirect once when n==1
req.statement: The system shall respond with a single 302 to /get when /redirect/1 is called.

doc.reasoning: The requirement states that GET /redirect/1 must issue exactly one 302 redirect to /get, and the final response (after following the redirect) must be HTTP 200 with the expected JSON payload. We need: (1) a positive test confirming the 302 → /get chain works correctly with exact status codes and Location header; (2) a negative test confirming that /redirect/0 is rejected (assert=n>0 triggers 500); (3) a boundary test at n=1 (the exact threshold where the code branches to url_for('view_get') instead of _redirect), plus a contrast at n=2 to confirm the branch is not taken. Additional tests cover the Location header value exactly, the final 200 payload keys, and the absolute=true variant to kill boolean-mutation operators.

tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_redirect_1_returns_302_with_location_to_get():
    r = client.get('/redirect/1', follow_redirects=False)
    assert r.status_code == 302
    location = r.headers.get('Location', '')
    assert location.endswith('/get'), f'Expected Location ending with /get, got: {location}'

test_redirect_1_returns_302_with_location_to_get()

tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_redirect_1_boundary_exactly_one_hop():
    r = client.get('/redirect/1', follow_redirects=False)
    assert r.status_code == 302, f'Expected 302, got {r.status_code}'
    location = r.headers.get('Location', '')
    assert location.endswith('/get'), f'Expected /get, got {location}'
    assert 'redirect' not in location, f'Should not redirect to another /redirect path: {location}'

from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_redirect_1_absolute_false_location_is_relative():
    r = client.get('/redirect/1', follow_redirects=False)
    assert r.status_code == 302
    location = r.headers.get('Location', '')
    assert not location.startswith('http://'), f'Expected relative URL, got {location}'
    assert not location.startswith('https://'), f'Expected relative URL, got {location}'
    assert location.endswith('/get')

from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_redirect_1_absolute_true_location_is_absolute():
    r = client.get('/redirect/1?absolute=true', follow_redirects=False)
    assert r.status_code == 302
    location = r.headers.get('Location', '')
    assert location.startswith('http://') or location.startswith('https://'), \

    assert location.endswith('/get'), f'Expected /get endpoint, got {location}'

tests.name: test_redirect_1_state_transition_302_then_200
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
actions: Step 2: Follow Location header manually — expect 200
trace: R-HTTPBIN-022: STC — state: initial -> redirecting(302) -> final(200); exactly one transition
tests.executable:
import json
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_redirect_1_state_transition_302_then_200():
    r1 = client.get('/redirect/1', follow_redirects=False)
    assert r1.status_code == 302
    location = r1.headers.get('Location', '')
    assert location != ''
    path = location if location.startswith('/') else '/' + location.split('/', 3)[-1]
    r2 = client.get(path, follow_redirects=False)
    assert r2.status_code == 200
    data = json.loads(r2.data)
    assert isinstance(data, dict)
    assert 'url' in data

test_redirect_1_state_transition_302_then_200()
